Read AGENTS.md, docs/README.md and docs/02_Investigation/GitHub-Tracking.md. Verify access to WuGing/VectorTileRenderer. Read open and closed issues with pagination, excluding PRs; reconcile local IDs and full GitHub URLs. Default to importing/triaging. When explicitly asked to publish or update issues, use the reviewed local proposal, check duplicates, preserve remote edits and record returned URLs. Do not post test issues or treat git pull as issue synchronization.
